newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo to do best to take over Thomson Multimedia.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to do best to take over Thomson Multimedia.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Group founder Kim Woo-choong said on Monday Daewoo Group would do its best to take over Thomson Multimedia (TMM).
"We will re-tender and do our best to take over Thomson Multimedia," Kim told reporters after a ceremony to mark the opening of Daewoo Motor Co's new plant in the southwestern city of Kunsan.

France last year called off a plan to sell the Thomson SA group, which owns defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF and television manufacturer Thomson Multimedia, after its privatisation commission objected.
The French government had previously expressed a preference for selling Thomson SA to Lagardere Groupe, which had planned to sell Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo.
The government since has decided to sell Thomson-CSF alone, and announced it would do so by private placement.
